blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (Any signed-in user can read any organization's invoice by id) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Scope the lookup to the caller's organization — `WHERE id = $1 AND org_id = $2` with `[id, currentUser(req).orgId]` — so another organization's invoice answers 404, exactly like a missing one. Add a test asserting the detail query is bound to the caller's `orgId`, as the list test does (CWE-639 / CWE-862, insecure direct object reference).
findings.title: Any signed-in user can read any organization's invoice by id

findings.recommendation: Answer a generic body such as `{ error: "internal error" }` and keep the message and stack in the server log only (CWE-209). The error is already logged by `console.error(err)`.
findings.title: The error handler sends the error message and stack trace to the client
